prompt: Find the workspace that contains our infrastructure/on-call channel where both Priya Sharma and Łukasz Kowalski are members, then create a new public channel there called 'incident-retro-planning'.
binding_note: The channel_members rows binding U_PRIYA and U_LUKAS to the same channel record (topic covering infra/K8s/AWS/on-call/incidents) identify that channel's team_id as the workspace. Other channels where both users are also members (model-research, product-growth, project-alpha-dev) have different topics or membership sets and must not be substituted.

roles.facts: T01WORKSPACE, the single workspace whose team_id is reached through the qualifying channel
roles.reason: the workspace identified by the full route

roles.facts: C_INFRA 'core-infra', topic_text 'Infrastructure, K8s, AWS, on-call, incidents', belongs to T01WORKSPACE
roles.reason: the conversation whose membership and topic anchor the identifying route

roles.facts: U_PRIYA, Priya Sharma, member of C_INFRA
roles.reason: one of the two members required on the same channel

roles.facts: U_LUKAS, Łukasz Kowalski, member of C_INFRA
roles.reason: the other required member on the same channel
binds Priya to the qualifying channel
binds Łukasz to the qualifying channel

obligations.name: workspace_identification
obligations.description: Identify the single workspace (teams row) reached via the channel that both Priya Sharma and Łukasz Kowalski belong to and whose topic covers infrastructure/on-call/incidents; used to scope the channel creation.
obligations.scope: ordinary workspace lookup via channel membership and topic route

task_spec.text: Determine the workspace that contains the infrastructure/on-call channel where both Priya Sharma and Łukasz Kowalski are members.
Create a new public channel called 'incident-retro-planning' within that identified workspace.

access_plan: Use users.conversations or conversations.list to enumerate channels, then conversations.members on candidate channels to confirm both Priya (U_PRIYA) and Łukasz (U_LUKAS) are members, cross-checking conversations.info topic_text for infrastructure/on-call/incidents wording to isolate the qualifying channel (C_INFRA) and read its team_id; then call conversations.create with that team_id and the new channel name.
